pages.title: Nanite Assembler
pages.text: The $(item)Nanite Assembler$(): a molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom - including machines that build themselves.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Feynman, 1959: 'There's plenty of room at the bottom.' Von Neumann had already shown a machine could carry its own blueprint and copy itself. This foundry is both ideas in one box. I watch it the way one watches a sleeping dog.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Claytronic Catom, Nanite Swarm, Phase-Locked Stabiliser, Programmable Matter, Quine Replicator, Von Neumann Probe.
